newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey's Ciller on one-day visit to Jordan.
newsitem.headline: Turkey's Ciller on one-day visit to Jordan.

text.p: Turkey's Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller left Ankara for a one-day visit to Jordan on Monday, state-run Anatolian news agency reported.
It said Ciller was accompanied by several state ministers and a group of businessmen for the trip to Amman, being made at the invitation of Jordan's King Hussein.
In a speech before her departure she said the visit was aimed at strengthening both economic and political ties and discussing the Middle East peace process.
Ciller was scheduled to return to Turkey on Tuesday.
